title: Small Language Models for Inference-Capability Routing: Effects of Model Capacity and Prompt Optimization on Downstream Quality and Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2611.16414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optional reasoning, retrieval, web search, and tool use can improve large language model responses but incur unnecessary computation when activated indiscriminately. This study investigates whether prompt optimization can compensate for limited router capacity and whether classification gains translate into downstream efficiency. The proposed framework uses prompt-driven small language models to make four independent capability decisions, allowing multiple capabilities to be selected per query. Qwen2.5 routers ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters are compared across five prompting strategies, followed by an evaluation of capability-specific optimized configurations using a fixed GPT-OSS-120B downstream model on 127 questions. Under minimal prompting, increasing router capacity does not consistently improve classification performance. translated_title: 面向推理能力路由的小型语言模型：模型容量与提示优化对下游质量和效率的影响
translated_abstract: 可选的推理、检索、网页搜索和工具使用等功能可以改善大语言模型的回答质量，但若不加区分地激活这些能力，则会带来不必要的计算开销。本研究探讨提示优化能否弥补路由器模型容量的不足，以及分类性能的提升能否转化为下游效率的改善。所提出的框架使用基于提示驱动的小型语言模型做出四项独立的能力决策，允许每个查询选择多种能力。研究比较了参数量从1.5B到14B的Qwen2.5路由器在五种提示策略下的表现，随后在127个问题上，使用固定的GPT-OSS-120B下游模型评估了针对各能力优化的配置。在最小提示条件下，增加路由器容量并不能持续提升分类性能。提示优化缩小了推理和计算器路由方面的容量差距，而RAG和网页搜索……
tldr: 该研究表明，提示优化能够在很大程度上弥补小型语言模型路由器容量不足的问题，使其在不增加模型规模的情况下实现高效的能力路由并提升下游效率。
en_tdlr: This study shows that prompt optimization largely compensates for limited capacity in small language model routers, enabling efficient capability routing and improved downstream efficiency without increasing model size.
